verdict.rationale: Gusto is expanding into small-business finance (banking, a cash-flow Money Dashboard), so automated invoice follow-up is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions invoicing, overdue-invoice reminders, or dunning automation. The Money Dashboard's view of 'what's coming in' is an adjacent cash-visibility feature, not automated collections follow-up.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have overdue invoices automatically followed up on without manual chasing
